policy: These programs exposed implementation issues and are development cases. The existing planning-corpus heldout sources remain separate.

scopes.ecs: Owned particle position/velocity update with wrapping u32 coordinates; no entity registry or structural changes.
scopes.game_engine: Topologically ordered translation forest propagation; no quaternion transforms, scheduling, scene allocation or rendering.
scopes.compiler: ASCII micro-language lexer over u32 code units, with complete token spans and kinds; not a language parser/compiler.
scopes.database: Dense bounded-domain modulo-u32 grouped sum; no SQL planning, storage, transactions or hash-domain fallback.
scopes.rendering: Ordered 2D orthographic AABB visibility scan; no BVH construction, ray tracing, shading or GPU rendering.
scopes.math: Square row-major u32-ring matrix multiplication with zero for missing entries; distinct from floating-point BLAS.
scopes.pathfinding: Complete four-neighbour unit-cost grid distance field with blocked cells; includes invalid-input sentinel behavior.
scopes.physics: Independent particle semi-implicit Euler with a floor bounce and strict f32 canonical NaNs; no broadphase or rigid-body constraint solver.
